description: Central Province - The Early Childhood Development Charter of Central Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new charter (Early Childhood Development Charter No. 03 of 2015) by the Central Provincial Council. It establishes legal frameworks, regulatory requirements, and compliance mechanisms for early childhood development centers, including registration procedures, operational standards, and enforcement provisions. While it mentions government officials (Chief Minister, Governor), the core content is about creating new legal/regulatory structures rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
